about_the_game:
Determine the fate of Ventreville! This emotional story-driven game features six unique playable characters, each with their own distinct game mechanics, stories, and narratives; their arcs tied together by the sudden murder of Ret and Flaire Avidine. Your choices and resulting endings will determine how many clues are available for the final protagonist, the detective, as she interrogates all the previous playable characters.

Start as Orven Zanry, an up-and-coming glassblower working for the esteemed Ret Avidine. Work to uncover the secrets of “Remedium,” the cure to the plague destroying the city of Ventreville. And as you learn more about the remedy, your hero, and your coworkers, realize that things are not as they seem…

Key Features

  • Choices with Consequences: Choose how you play Orven, and see the characters shift based on your choices

  • Butterfly Effect: Determine the fate of Ventreville and its inhabitants with branching routes, some silly and some dire

  • Replay to find all the unique endings

  • More than 75k words for 2.5 hours of gameplay per playthrough

  • Enjoy the stylish character designs

  • Live in Ventreville through the expressive backgrounds

  • Hear the city through an original soundtrack

  • First chapter of a six-chapter game

content_descriptors.notes:
Though not visually gory or graphic, this game deals with mature themes. Viewer's discretion advised, especially if sensitive to the following topics. TW:  alcoholism, medicinal usage of illegal substances, drug trafficking, crime, kidnapping, death, murder, suicide, PTSD, violence, mutilation of a body.

There is a chapter of the game that is explicitly psychological horror and includes: cults, demons, kidnapping.  This chapter is skippable with no repercussions.

Minimum:

  • Processor: x86_32 CPU with SSE2 instructions, or any x86_64 CPU
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM

Make your choices count! The final protagonist, the interrogating detective, will only know as much as your previous characters know…
